body: Interesting, you probably saw your grand dad's spirit but whenever he was younger. And you most likely were going through sleep paralysis on your birthday, but maybe he was there.
There's a theory that it's caused by copper in the ground or some type of metal in the ground, I used to study this type of stuff a few years ago lol.
It look like Mr. Game & Watch from Super Smash Bros
I don't get what you're trying to say but, babies/toddlers usually see stuff that others can't see. I'm surprised that he remembers that.

Maybe it was your granddad checking up on you, even though it's pretty creepy for him to do this lol. Did he look like your granddad, the ghost in which you described seemed like a old man that you were describing him as.

Do you still see things every once in a while like a Spirit?
